title: Cardiac Positron Emission Tomography (PET) Myocardial Perfusion Imaging
description: CMS National Coverage Determination for Rubidium-82 / Ammonia N-13 PET myocardial perfusion imaging (NCD 220.6). Requires known or intermediate-to-high risk suspected coronary artery disease (CAD), inconclusive or uninterpretable prior SPECT or stress ECG, or severe obesity (BMI >= 35) precluding adequate SPECT quality.

criteria.name: Intermediate-to-High Pre-Test CAD Probability
criteria.description: Documented intermediate or high pre-test probability of ischemic coronary artery disease based on symptoms, age, and cardiac risk factors.
criteria.source_text_excerpt: Effective for services performed on or after October 1, 2003, PET scans performed at rest or with pharmacological stress used for noninvasive imaging of the perfusion of the heart for the diagnosis and management of patients with known or suspected coronary artery disease using the FDA-approved radiopharmaceutical ammonia N-13 are covered, provided the requirements below are met:

criteria.name: Suboptimal SPECT Imaging or Severe Obesity (BMI >= 35 kg/m2)
criteria.description: Documented prior inconclusive/equivocal SPECT stress test, or severe obesity with BMI >= 35 kg/m2 causing severe soft tissue attenuation artifact.
criteria.clinical_intent: Justify necessity of PET over standard SPECT
